main_text.p: ò[?] ex toto capite unde illa deprompsi-is, in mendo cubare verba controversa rito conjecit Dallæus: verùm mendo-esse illa verba, vel saltem aliquam in s esse transpositionem aliâ viâ demon-stre aggrediar, ut res melius procedat edam imprimis consideranda veniunt. Canones istos ab Apostolis conditos at, ab Authenticis Ecclesiæ regulis excludit, non per omnia recipiendos et, & in Canonum libris seorsim ante ncilia[?] ad instructionem,& propter vul-am eorum famam poni affirmat ; 2. bat hos Canones ab Apostolis minimè ditos esse, ex eo quod præter quinque, s enumerat Synodos[?], nullam aliam ostoli habuisse legantur, in qua istos nones condiderint : 3. ab authenticis robatis Ecclesiæ regulis excludi often-Gelasiani Decreti auctoritate, in quo memorantur regulæ omnes probatæ uthenticæ, nullâ prorsus Canonum ostolicorum mentione factâ ; tamen t constabat hos Canones Gelasij con-ito fuisse notatos, hoc quoque obser-: non neglexit Hincmarus in verbis mox citavimus, de his Apostolorum nibus penitùs tacuit, sed nec inter apo-ba eos misit. Vnius vocula nec transl-io verborum istorum sensum turba-

page.notes: The left edge of the scan is cut off, so the first word of each line is a fragment and is kept as such. Doubtful: the initial "ò", "ncilia" and "Synodos" (a blot covers the letters after "Syn"). The line "ba eos misit." is the start of "Apostolorum"-line continuation as printed in italics. The text ends mid-word with "turba-" and continues on the next page.
